title: Uko Wakuramo Videwo kuri X (Twitter) mu Buryo Bworoshye
description: Uko wakuramo videwo kuri X (Twitter) ukoresheje telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa nta app, nta kwinjira. Koporora link, uyomeke kuri I Need Save, uhitemo ubwiza.
photoCaption: Kuramo videwo iri ku nyandiko ya X.
photo2Caption: Koporora link ukoresheje akamenyetso ka Sangiza.
body:
X, yahoze yitwa Twitter, akenshi ni ho videwo zikwirakwira cyane zibanza kugaragara: uduce tw'amakuru, ibihe bidasanzwe by'imikino, kugeza kuri meme abantu bose bavugaho. Ikibazo ni uko kubika izo videwo muri Gallery bitoroha buri gihe nko gukanda buto imwe. Humura, ushobora gukuramo videwo kuri X (Twitter) mu buryo bworoshye ukoresheje I Need Save. Ni ubuntu, nta app, kandi nta kwinjira.

Iyi mfashanyigisho isobanura intambwe kuri telefoni no kuri mudasobwa, amadosiye ushobora guhitamo, n'icyo wakora niba gukuramo byanze.

Mbere yo Gutangira

Reba neza ko videwo ushaka kubika iri ku nyandiko rusange. Inyandiko ziri kuri konti zifunze, ibikubiyemo bishobora kurebwa gusa nyuma yo kwinjira, cyangwa ibyabujijwe mu turere tumwe ntibishobora gukurwamo.

Kandi ntukeneye gutanga uburenganzira bwo kwinjira muri konti yawe ya X. I Need Save ikenera link y'inyandiko gusa.

Uko Wakuramo Videwo kuri X (Twitter) ukoresheje Telefoni

Izi ntambwe zikora kuri Android no kuri iPhone:

  1. Fungura app ya X maze ushake inyandiko irimo videwo ushaka kubika.
  2. Kanda buto ya Sangiza (Share) kuri iyo nyandiko.
  3. Hitamo Koporora link (Copy link).
  4. Fungura mushakisha (browser) maze ujye kuri ineedsave.com.
  5. Omeka link mu gasanduku kabugenewe, cyangwa ukande buto ya Omeka.
  6. Kanda Kuramo maze utegereze amahitamo agaragare.
  7. Hitamo ubwiza bwa videwo wifuza, maze gukuramo bitangire.

Rimwe na rimwe buto yandikaho Birimo gutegurwa…. Bisobanura ko videwo ibanza gutunganywa, urugero stream irimo guhindurwa MP4 cyangwa amashusho n'amajwi birimo guhuzwa. Reka urupapuro rukomeze gufunguye, maze gukuramo bitangire ubwabyo dosiye imaze kwitegura.

Uko Wakuramo Videwo za X kuri Mudasobwa

Niba ufungurira X muri mushakisha ya mudasobwa, nabwo biroroshye:

  1. Fungura inyandiko irimo videwo.
  2. Koporora link yayo ukoresheje menu ya Sangiza cyangwa aho bandika aderesi.
  3. Fungura urupapuro rwo gukuramo muri tab nshya maze womeke link.
  4. Kanda Kuramo, hanyuma uhitemo ihitamo ushaka.

Dosiye izabikwa mu bubiko bwa Downloads kuri mudasobwa.

Amahitamo Uzabona

Link imaze gutunganywa, I Need Save yerekana amahitamo akurikije inyandiko y'umwimerere. Akenshi uzabona:

  • Videwo mu bwiza butandukanye, urugero 360p, 720p cyangwa 1080p. Ubwiza buboneka biterwa na videwo yashyizweho.
  • Amajwi, haba mu bwiza bw'umwimerere cyangwa MP3 ya 192 kbps ihinduwe ivuye muri videwo.
  • Ifoto / Ifoto ntoya y'inyandiko.

Ihitamo ry'amajwi rifite akamaro niba ukeneye ijwi gusa, urugero agace k'ikiganiro cyangwa umuziki. Intambwe zose wazisoma mu nyandiko uko wahindura videwo zo ku mbuga nkoranyambaga MP3.

Inama: Niba ushaka gusa kongera kuyireba kuri telefoni, 720p akenshi iba igaragara neza bihagije kandi itwara umwanya muto kurusha 1080p.

Kuki Wakoresha I Need Save?

Hari ibintu byinshi bituma ubu buryo bworoha gukoresha buri munsi:

  • Nta app. Byose bikorerwa muri mushakisha, bityo ububiko bwa telefoni ntibutwarwa n'indi app.
  • Nta kwinjira. Ntukeneye gufungura konti cyangwa guhuza konti yawe ya X.
  • Si kuri X gusa. Ubu buryo bukora no kuri TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, Bluesky n'izindi mbuga zishyigikiwe.
  • Biroroshye gukoresha. Urubuga ruboneka mu ndimi 93 kandi rukurikiza insanganyamatsiko y'urumuri cyangwa y'umwijima y'igikoresho cyawe.

Aho Dosiye Iri Nyuma yo Kuyikuramo

  • Android na mudasobwa: dosiye ijya mu bubiko bwa Downloads. Kuri Android, app ya Gallery rimwe na rimwe ifata akanya gato mbere yo kuyigaragaza.
  • iPhone/iPad (Safari): dosiye ijya muri app ya Files, mu bubiko bwa Downloads. Kugira ngo uyimurire muri app ya Photos, fungura videwo muri Files, ukande Share, hanyuma uhitemo Save Video.

Videwo za MP4 ukuyemo zifite igihe nyacyo kandi zikina muri Gallery. Dosiye kandi iva kuri X ijya ako kanya ku gikoresho cyawe, itabitswe kuri seriveri ya I Need Save.

Niba Gukuramo Byanze

Dore impamvu zikunze kubaho:

  • Konti ifunze. Videwo ziri kuri konti yihariye ntizishobora gukurwamo.
  • Bisaba kwinjira. Ibikubiyemo bishobora kurebwa gusa nyuma yo kwinjira muri konti nabyo ntibishobora gukurwamo.
  • Kubuzwa mu turere tumwe. Videwo zabujijwe mu bihugu bimwe ntiziboneka.
  • Link itari yo. Reba neza ko wakoporoye link y'inyandiko, atari iya profili. Yongere uyikoporore ukoresheje buto ya Sangiza.

Ntiwibagirwe Imyitwarire Myiza

Bika videwo zo gukoresha ku giti cyawe. Niba ushaka kuzongera gusangiza ku zindi mbuga, saba uruhushya uwazikoze kandi uvuge izina rye. Kubaha uburenganzira bw'abahanzi bituma bakomeza kugira imbaraga zo guhanga. Soma kandi imyitwarire n'uburenganzira bw'umuhanzi mu gukuramo ibikubiyemo kugira ngo ubone ibisobanuro birambuye.

Ibibazo Bikunze Kubazwa

Ese I Need Save ikora kuri iPhone?

Yego. Fungura ineedsave.com muri Safari, ukurikize intambwe zimwe, hanyuma ushake videwo muri app ya Files.

Ese ngomba kwinjira muri konti yanjye ya X?

Oya. Omeka gusa link y'inyandiko rusange, nta kwinjira kandi nta gufungura konti.

Kuki buto yandikaho Birimo gutegurwa…?

Videwo irimo gutunganywa, urugero stream irimo guhindurwa MP4. Gukuramo biratangira ubwabyo nibirangira.
